title: Isolation of stromal vascular fraction cell suspensions from mouse and human adipose tissues for downstream applications
protocol: Weigh the adipose tissue.
Add 2 mL of ice-cold Wash/Digestion buffer per gram of sample.
Mince the adipose tissue using sterile scissors.
Add 200 μL Collagenase II and 2.5 μL DNase per mL of Wash/Digestion buffer.
Check the LOT number and corresponding enzymatic activity in Units per mg for Collagenase II and DNase stock solutions.
Ensure all adipose tissue is floating, removing any non-adipose tissue that sinks to the bottom of the tube.
Place samples in a shaker-incubator at 37°C and 225 rpm for 25–30 minutes.
Transfer samples through a 100 μm cell sieve into a 50 mL tube pre-washed with ice cold Wash/Digestion buffer.
Top up the Falcon tube to 30 mL with Wash/Digestion buffer.
Rinse the sample tube used for digestion with Wash/Digestion buffer and strain through the same 100 μm cell sieve.
Centrifuge samples at 800 × g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Open the tubes after centrifugation to check that the floating portion of the sample is composed of transparent lipid droplets.
Remove any white layer of adipose tissue floating with a Pasteur pipette if present.
Re-digest remaining material in 2 mL Wash/Digestion buffer with half the original collagenase volume used, including DNase for 10 minutes.
Discard supernatant after re-digestion.
The remaining pellet contains stromal vascular fraction cells.
Re-suspend the cell pellet in ice cold 1× binding buffer containing Dead Cell Removal MicroBeads at 200 μL per 10^7 cells.
Transfer the sample into fresh tubes to prevent excess lipids from affecting the sample.
Pass the sample through a magnetic column to remove dead cells.
Collect the effluent as the live cell enriched population.
Top-up the collected live cells with MACs buffer and centrifuge at 350 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in ice cold MACs buffer containing CD11c MicroBeads.
Centrifuge the sample at 350 × g for 5 min at 4°C to pellet the cells.
Take single cell suspensions and centrifuge at 350 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Resuspend cell pellets in 75 μL of PBS containing diluted fluorescently conjugated extracellular antibody markers following manufacturer’s instructions.
Incubate cells in the dark at 4°C for 18 min.
Add ice-cold PBS.
Centrifuge at 350 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend pellet in ice-cold MACs buffer as a wash.
Centrifuge at 350 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend pellet in a small volume of MACs buffer.
Proceed to flow cytometry-assisted cell sorting.
